visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor space with white walls. Three individuals are present: a young girl in the foreground wearing a striped and cream-colored top, a woman behind her wearing a white cap and glasses, and a young man in the background. The girl looks at the camera while large, colorful text with musical notes appears in the lower half of the frame. The woman behind her flashes a peace sign and smiles. (2) The scene transitions to the start of a game. A grid of eight images, mostly of animals like pigs, dogs, and birds, appears at the bottom of the screen. The young girl begins to rhythmically chant while moving her hands. Behind her, the woman and the man are seen moving and waiting for their turn. The lighting is consistent and bright, with a minimalist home background. (3) The woman in the white cap moves to the front, pushing the girl aside. She continues the rhythmic game, looking at a new set of images in the grid and speaking excitedly. She wears a white T-shirt with text and a 'Celine' logo on her white cap. Her hands clap and move in time with the beat as she focuses on the screen. (4) The young man, wearing glasses and a cream sweater, jumps into the frame, replacing the woman. He participates in a round where the grid displays various food items instead of animals. His facial expressions are animated and focused as he tries to keep up with the fast-pacing game. The camera remains static, capturing their energetic movements as they swap positions. (5) The game cycles through several more rounds, including household tools and celebrity faces. The three characters continuously push each other in and out of the primary shot, laughing and maintaining high energy. The background remains the same neutral indoor wall, and yellow variety-style captions occasionally appear to emphasize their reactions or mistakes during the challenge.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy rhythmic clapping beat accompanied by a bright, synthesizer-based melody. Three distinct voices—two female and one male—are heard speaking and laughing in Mandarin. The main young girl's voice is clear and excited as she explains the challenge over the steady 120 BPM drum machine beat. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks the start of the first round. The girl chants animal names rhythmically: 'Zhu-zhu, Gou-gou, Niao-niao, Ji-zhu.' Her pitch is energetic and varied. The BGM remains constant with a strong percussive pulse. Background laughter and playful shouting are audible as they switch turns. (3) The second female voice takes over with high arousal and a faster speech rate, continuing the rhythmic pattern. The sound of fabric rustling is heard as they playfully push each other. The male voice is heard in the background teasing and laughing, adding to the chaotic, festive acoustic atmosphere. (4) The male voice moves to the foreground, exhibiting a deeper pitch but maintaining the same fast, rhythmic tempo. He encounters a difficult set of words, resulting in stutters and comedic vocal strain. The BGM beat stays perfectly synchronized with their speech. Occasional cartoon-like slide whistle or 'whoosh' sound effects emphasize their rapid movements. (5) The final segment features all three voices overlapping in a cacophony of laughter and shouting. The music reaches its climax with a consistent, driving beat. One voice yells 'Mama, ni lai!' (Mom, your turn!) with high intensity. The audio concludes with a final burst of laughter and the fading out of the electronic BGM track.
